title: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting software
requirement: Landlords may not use, sell or license software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rent data to set rents or occupancy levels.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in the city
exemptions: Public housing authority units; owner-occupied buildings of four or fewer units
penalty: Civil penalty up to $1,000 per violation; each unit and each month is a separate violation
quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic rent-setting device to set the rent or occupancy level of any residential dwelling unit in the City of Cambridge.

title: Cap on tenant application and screening fees
requirement: A proposed ordinance would cap application and screening fees at $50 and require receipts and refunds. It has not been passed.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in the city
quoted_span: No landlord shall charge a prospective tenant an application or screening fee exceeding fifty dollars ($50) per application.

title: Cap on security deposits
requirement: A landlord may not take a security deposit above 1.5 times the monthly rent, must keep it in an interest-bearing account and return it with interest within 30 days.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in the city
exemptions: Owner-occupied buildings with two or fewer rental units
penalty: Twice the amount wrongfully withheld, plus court costs
quoted_span: A landlord shall not demand or accept a security deposit of more than one and one-half (1.5) times the monthly rent for a residential rental unit.

title: Tenant Fair Chance Ordinance
requirement: Landlords may not ask about criminal history before a conditional offer and may not refuse an applicant for using a voucher or other lawful source of income.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in the city
exemptions: Owner-occupied buildings with four or fewer units
quoted_span: A landlord may not ask about an applicant's criminal history before making a conditional offer.
